code.sample_tools: tools/build_sample.py (root Qwen runtime), tools/policy_check.py (scripts/source_variants/qwen_policy under scripts/belt_ext/d53/run_patched.py), run as one CPU job

inputs.declared_by: scoring summary and representation dump source

inputs.role: scored report pool (beliefs at every probe)
scoring summary (the package's seed-0 scoring receipt)
validation scores after answer elicitation (policy-fit input)

production.trajectories: vLLM 0.9.0.1 on RTX 4090 (ETH Euler); temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20; 12,000-token thinking budget
production.natural_answer_elicitation: CSCS GH200 node, the cluster container's vLLM build, code commit aa3910bb2072916aa69a6c123d0f3bb12c76ecda
production.policy_fitting: CPU, float64 L-BFGS, producer scripts/source_variants/qwen_policy (source revision 521553ad), elicited-answer cost installer scripts/belt_ext/d53

selection.rule: for each required category set, the question whose chains cover it, source='math500' if any, with minimum sha256('belt-sample-v1:'+qkey); all chains of each chosen question

checks.field_agreement: trajectory, scored-pool and elicited-bank rows agree on gold, outcome, blocks, thinking_tokens, block_ends, query_points and probes for all 16 chains; completion_ids identical in the trajectory file and the elicited bank
checks.prefix_boundaries: every probe prefix decodes to text ending in a blank line
checks.representation_rows: one finite float16 row of width 768 per probe for every chain
checks.public_b_normalisation: B-R mean and std recomputed from the checkpoint package's seed-0/val_scored.jsonl (SHA256 6e1b9ce1aab4ea71fd8613b40c01ace686c9f9e4422ba24e74a52121d1adfc2b) match policies/belt_b_r_seed0.json exactly (maximum absolute difference 0.0)
checks.scoring_copies: the Euler copies read here are byte-identical to the Clariden files named in the package's seed-0 scoring receipt (scored pool, summary, report and validation representation dumps)

policy_normalisation.method: mean and std recomputed from the policy-fit questions with the fitting code; all 17 stored rows of each policy re-read on the development split and on the pool the cell was written for
